tasks.label: Build SQLTools release VSIX
tasks.command: $env:NODE_ENV='production'; Set-Location build-tools; node --max_old_space_size=8192 .\node_modules\webpack\bin\webpack.js --env pkg=extension; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Set-Location ..\packages\extension; & ..\..\node_modules\.bin\vsce.cmd package --yarn --allow-star-activation -o ..\..\sqltools-0.28.44.vsix }

tasks.label: Build PostgreSQL release VSIX
tasks.command: Set-Location packages\driver.pg; npm run build:ext; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { npm run build:ls; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { 'y' | & ..\..\node_modules\.bin\vsce.cmd package --yarn --allow-star-activation -o ..\..\sqltools-driver-pg-0.5.13.vsix } }

tasks.label: Build Oracle release VSIX
tasks.command: Set-Location ..\sqltools-Oracle-driver; npm run esbuild:ext; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { npm run esbuild:ls; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { & ..\vscode-sqltools\node_modules\.bin\vsce.cmd package --yarn --allow-star-activation -o sqltools-oracle-driver-0.1.23.vsix } }
